comment: ANCHOR: CIO_OVERNIGHT_BRIEF_LANE_REGISTRATION_20261108 — LQ-20261107-1286 (operator GO relayed in WORK-QUEUE):
scripts/cio_overnight_brief.py is an n8n lane at canary. The row, allowlist entry, health contract and this test
agree on the cadence (trading days 06:00/09:00/12:00/16:15/20:00 ET, weekends every 6 h, plus a market_event
trigger that is DECLARED BUT INERT while EVENT_MODES = ('dry_run',)), on the two argvs (--dry-run and --apply),
and on the 12 h longest gap. Both argvs are emulated against a throwaway state root: the dry run writes
nothing, the live form writes latest.json + the dated copy with no lane receipt.
